rules.message: uses a task API that SDK 4 renamed or deprecated (handleError, init, cleanup, toolTask, ai.tool, metadata.stream, onStart)
rules.fix: catchError instead of handleError; middleware and locals instead of init/cleanup; schemaTask with ai.toolExecute instead of toolTask/ai.tool; streams.pipe instead of metadata.stream; onStartAttempt instead of onStart

rules.message: @trigger.dev/* and trigger.dev versions differ across package.json files, or a 3.x version is pinned
rules.fix: align every @trigger.dev/* package and trigger.dev to one version, then run npx trigger.dev@latest update

rules.message: zod is pinned below 3.25.56 (unsupported by Trigger.dev), or an instanceof z.ZodError check is used, which does not match Zod 4 errors
rules.fix: upgrade zod to ^3.25.56 || ^4.0.0 (including overrides/resolutions); read errors from result.error.issues instead of instanceof z.ZodError; import zod/v4 for composed schemas

rules.message: trigger.config leaves runtime unset or set to node, so tasks follow the current Node.js LTS
rules.fix: pin a runtime such as node-24 (node-22 and node-26 are also available) when reproducible builds matter

rules.message: OTEL exporters are pinned to 0.52.x, or configured through OTEL_* env vars; with SDK 4 exporters take constructor arguments in trigger.config
rules.fix: move the @opentelemetry exporter packages to 0.203.x and pass endpoint and headers as constructor arguments instead of OTEL_* env vars
